cover.house: A board and batten gable and a covered porch face the street on this East End bungalow, behind a concrete front walk. Outside are Hardi Plank siding, a new roof and a new driveway; inside, new wiring and breaker box, three-phase power and new plumbing. A fenced backyard with a covered garage sits behind the house, and the house has never flooded.

oh.write: A board and batten gable and a covered porch face the street on this East End bungalow, behind a concrete front walk.
